yes.text: Yes - The H&S policy statement is displayed on the Health and Safety noticeboard.
Yes - The current full H&S policy is available for staff to refer to.

no.text: No - The H&S policy statement is not displayed on the Health and Safety noticeboard.
No - The current full H&S policy could not be made available during the visit.

yes.text: Yes - The H&S policy is signed by the Chief Financial Officer on {date}.
Yes - The H&S policy statement is the current version, dated 19 March 2026.
Yes - Local H&S responsibilities are clearly recorded and understood.

no.text: No - The policy has not been signed.
No - The H&S policy statement is dated before 19 March 2026 and is out of date. Replace it with the current version.
No - Local H&S responsibilities are not clear.

yes.text: Yes - The risk-assessment register covers the relevant tasks carried out at this store.
Yes - Relevant staff groups are covered by the assessments reviewed.

no.text: No - Relevant tasks are missing from the risk-assessment register.
No - The assessments do not cover all relevant staff groups.

yes.text: Yes - The staff sampled explained the controls for the two selected risks.
Yes - The controls demonstrated matched the assessments reviewed.

no.text: No - The staff sampled could not explain the selected controls.
No - The working practices observed did not match the assessment controls.

yes.text: Yes - The assessments reviewed have been updated to reflect relevant changes.
Yes - Learning from the incidents or repeat findings reviewed is reflected in the assessments.

no.text: No - Relevant changes have not been reflected in the assessments.
No - The incidents or repeat findings reviewed have not led to an assessment update.

yes.text: Yes - The staff records sampled show induction completed before unsupervised work.

no.text: No - Staff are working unsupervised before completing induction.

no.text: No - Required refresher modules remain incomplete for eligible staff.
